Bike shops in Tucson: repairs, parts, rentals

Repairs, rentals and fits in Tucson. Call ahead on event weekends.

For: El Tour de Tucson.

Bike shops in Tucson: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

What do you need?

  1. Fair Wheel Bikes

    • Repairs
    • Rentals: road, gravel, MTB, e-bike
    • Bike fits
    • Parts
    • 1110 E 6th St, Tucson, AZ 85719
    (520) 884-9018DirectionsWebsite
    More about Fair Wheel Bikes

    About a mile northeast of downtown, near University and Euclid, where the Shootout (Saturdays, 7:30 am) and the Tuesday Morning Fast Ride (Tuesdays, 7:30 am) start; the shop posts both rides’ start times. The 6th Street store sells and hands out rentals and is closed Sundays. Repairs and FitWorks fittings happen at the Park Avenue Studio, 503 S Park Ave, (520) 624-3045, Monday to Friday 8 to 5 by call or email (tune-up $120; fit $125 an hour, usually 2 to 3 hours; Oct 2026). Rents a real fleet, first day (Oct 2026): aluminum road $65, carbon Shimano 105 $100, 105 Di2 $115, ENVE with SRAM AXS $135, Trek Checkpoint ALR gravel $75, mountain bikes $65 to $100, e-road and e-gravel $150. Extra days discounted; helmet, flat kit and your choice of pedals included.

  2. Pima Street Bicycle

    Midtown on Speedway, about 3 miles northeast of downtown.

    • Repairs
    • Parts
    • Suspension
    • Takes shipped bikes
    • 3400 E Speedway Blvd, Suite 108, Tucson, AZ 85716
    (520) 326-4044DirectionsWebsite
    More about Pima Street Bicycle

    A service-first shop that sells Giant and Liv. The one shop whose own site says to call and have your bike shipped straight to it: standard assembly $100, e-bike $149 (Oct 2026). Tune-ups $69 to $239, suspension from $65 (Oct 2026). Tuesday to Friday 10 to 6, Saturday 9 to 5, closed Sunday and Monday.

  3. Earlybird Bikes

    Near the base of the Mount Lemmon climb on Tanque Verde Road, about 10 miles northeast of downtown and on the same road as LeBuzz.

    • Repairs
    • Rentals: road, gravel, MTB, e-bike
    • 8969 E Tanque Verde Rd, Suite 213, Tucson, AZ 85749
    (520) 372-2016DirectionsWebsite
    More about Earlybird Bikes

    Services almost every make, e-bikes included; the shop says to just stop by or call. Opens at 8 on Monday, Friday and weekends: Monday and Friday 8 to 5, Tuesday and Thursday 10 to 5, Saturday and Sunday 8 to 4, closed Wednesday (out riding, it says). Rents Bianchi and Cannondale road, e-road and gravel bikes and Transition mountain bikes, one day to a week, with flat pedals, a flat kit and cages. SPD or SPD-SL pedals and a helmet cost extra, and prices show only in the booking system (Oct 2026).

  4. Bicycle Ranch Tucson

    On Oracle Road about 8 miles north of downtown, the shop for Oro Valley, Catalina State Park and the north side.

    • Repairs
    • Bike fits
    • Parts
    • Shop rides
    • 7090 N Oracle Rd #156, Tucson, AZ 85704

    The shop ride: Bicycle Ranch Saturday Roundup (Saturdays, 7:00 am) →

    (520) 219-4311DirectionsWebsite
    More about Bicycle Ranch Tucson

    the Saturday Roundup (Saturdays, 7:00 am) is the shop’s own ride. Open every day: Monday to Saturday 10 to 6, Sunday 11 to 4. Services all makes; standard tune $125, flat repair $20, and it boxes a bike to ship home for $75 with materials (Oct 2026). El Tour de Tucson’s shipping page names it the partner shop that receives riders’ bikes, $55 to assemble or $90 with repacking after the ride (Oct 2026). The shop’s own pages don’t say so, so call before you ship.

  5. Transit Cycles

    • Repairs
    • Suspension
    • Shop rides
    • 267 S Avenida del Convento, Bldg 10, Tucson, AZ 85745

    Nearby ride: Third Thursday Westside Community Ride (3rd Thursday of the month, 5:30 pm, rolls about 6:10 pm) →

    (520) 396-4525DirectionsWebsite
    More about Transit Cycles

    In the MSA Annex in the Mercado district, under a mile west of downtown and beside the Loop, on the same street as the Mercado start of the Women’s Shootout (Saturdays, 7:45 am). Woman-owned, in the shop’s own words. Jenna, certified by Shimano, SRAM and Bosch, does flats, brake bleeds, suspension overhauls and wheel builds, and works on Rad Power and Aventon e-bikes. Tuesday to Saturday 10 to 6, Sunday 11 to 4, closed Monday. No rentals, fitting or shipping on the site. Its monthly evening cruise to Dragoon Brewing leaves from here.

  6. Ajo Bikes

    South side, about 3 to 4 miles south of downtown and the closest pick to the airport for a bike that arrives broken.

    • Repairs
    • 1301 E Ajo Way #117, Tucson, AZ 85713
    (520) 294-1434DirectionsWebsite
    More about Ajo Bikes

    Tuesday to Friday 10 to 6, Saturday 10 to 5, closed Sunday and Monday. Repair is on the site; prices and turnaround aren’t, so call first.
